g.text: When to use what

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: | # | System | Suggested Architecture | Why |

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji
Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: | 1 | Small Blog | Monolithic | Simple CRUD, low traffic |

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: | 2 | Portfolio Website | Serverless | Minimal backend, cost-efficient |

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: | 3 | E-commerce MVP | Monolithic | Quick to build, easy deployment |

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: | 4 | E-commerce Large | Microservices | Independent scaling of Order, Payment, Inventory |

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: | 5 | Ride Sharing | Event-Driven | Asynchronous workflows for ride assignment & billing |

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: | 6 | Chat App | Event-Driven | Real-time messaging, decoupled services |

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: | 7 | Image Upload Service | Serverless | Triggered by S3, no server management |

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: | 8 | Payment Gateway | Microservices | Independent services for payment processing & fraud detection |

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji
